headline: Vote on draft FY27 funding application form, eligibility applications, and draft FY27 Community Preservation Plan for public comment.
summary: Members will vote on a draft funding application form and on eligibility applications. They will also review a draft Community Preservation Plan and FY26 Annual Report for public comment.
items: Vote on draft FY27 funding application form
Vote on determination of eligibility for applications received
Review draft FY27 Community Preservation Plan for release for public comment, and vote to accept the plan and FY26 Annual Report and release them for public comment
Other business: election of chair and vice chair, and funding availability update

CITY OF SALEM, MASSACHUSETTS 
Dominick Pangallo, Mayor

MEETING NOTICE AND AGENDA - REVISED 
 
Notice is hereby given that the Community Preservation Committee will hold a 
Public Meeting on  
Wednesday, November 10, 2026 at 6:00 P.M. via remote participation 
in accordance with Chapter 2 of the Act of 2025. 
 
Individuals may participate remotely in the meeting via a remote participation platform called 
Zoom. Members of the public and/or parties with a right and/or requirement to attend this meeting 
may access the remote participation meeting through any one of the following ways: 
 
• To use the website link, click 
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82034866491?pwd=vJOsyc0DkZkuZQW6lDerx2NBKqDNw.1   
and copy it into your web browser to join the meeting; or  
• Go to the website link https://zoom.us/join and enter Webinar ID # 820 3486 6491 and 
enter Password 766861 ; or 
• Dial the toll-free phone number 877-853-5257. When prompted, enter Webinar ID #  
820 3486 6491 , followed by the meeting password 766861 , if directed. Those only 
dialing in will not have access to the direct video feed of the meeting. 
 
 
Providing Public Comment During the Meeting: 
 
Members of the public attending this meeting virtually will be allowed to make comments, if they 
wish to do so, during the portion of the meeting designated for public comment. During portions 
of the meeting in which public comment is permitted, members of the public who have “raised 
their hand” in Zoom will be unmuted and called on to offer comment. In order to raise a hand, 
members of the public using the Zoom computer or phone application may click the “Raise 
Hand” button; members of the public dialing in may press the star key followed by the number 
nine (*9), to raise their hand to speak. Attendees will be called on by their screenname or the 
last 3 digits of their telephone number. When called on, the moderator will ask the attendee to 
unmute their device and provide their full name, address and comment for the record.
Community Preservation Committee  
Meeting Notice and Agenda 11-10-26

COMMUNITY PRESERVATION COMMITTEE 
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 10, 2026 
6:00 PM 
MEETING AGENDA 
 
1) Public Comment 
 
2) Approval of minutes of 10/14/25 
 
3) Review and Vote on Draft FY27 funding application form 
 
4) Review and Vote on Determination of Eligibility Applications received (applications 
viewable here) 
 
5) Review of written comments received 
 
6) Review Draft Community Preservation Plan for release for public comment 
o Vote to accept the draft FY27 Community Preservation Plan and FY26 Annual 
Report as presented/modified and to release it for a public comment period and 
that, after the close of the public comment period, to approve the final plan if 
minor or no public comments are received and proceed with announcing 
application deadlines. 
 
7) Other Business 
o Discussion/Election of Chair and Vice Chair 
o Funding Availability Update 
 
8) Next meetings:   
o Tuesday, December 8, 2026, 6:00pm (tentative) 
o Tuesday, January 12, 2027, 6:00pm 
 
 
November 3, 2026     
         Patti Kelleher 
                                                  CPA Administrator
